reviewer_notes: Article Twelve C.2/C.3/C.5 (PDF page 21, printed footer 20) states all three guarantees: junior and senior high teachers get daily prep of one class period; elementary teachers five preparatory periods per week of not less than forty-five minutes; elementary specialists a minimum of five preps per week of no less than 30 minutes (Appendix K p.52 and Appendix L p.53 only add committee/intent language, no different guarantee). A quotes C.2, C.3 and C.5 verbatim with their governing subjects and cites PDF page 21, which is correct. B has the right three figures but its evidence is a stitched, ellipsis-joined quote whose first fragment drops the governing words 'The Board shall make every reasonable effort to provide all teachers in the junior and senior high schools', and its page 21 is reported as 20 (it used the printed footer number, which runs one behind the PDF page here); B also labels the secondary tier 'High school' where the clause covers junior and senior high.
